case_name: Ishrat And Another vs Ut Of Jk & Ors
facts_of_case: Petitioners sought protection from respondent No. 5, father of petitioner No. 1, due to alleged threat, harassment and interference after petitioner No. 1's marriage to petitioner No. 2.

legal_principles.principle: Aadhar Card is not a conclusive proof of date of birth.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Apex Court in a case titled 'Saroj & Ors Vs. Iffco-Tokio General Insurance Co. & Ors' (Civil Appeal No. 012077-012078 of 2024) (2024 INSC 819), has held that Aadhar Card is not a conclusive as proof of date of birth.
applicable_acts_sections: Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection of Children) Act, 2015 — Section 94
cited_cases: Saroj & Ors Vs. Iffco-Tokio General Insurance Co. & Ors, (2024) INSC 819

legal_principles.principle: School leaving certificates need to be given preference as proof of date of birth.
legal_principles.held: That school leaving certificates need to be given preference as Aadhar serves as a unique identification tool and should not be treated as conclusive proof especially when other statutorily recognized documents are available.
applicable_acts_sections: Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection of Children) Act, 2015 — Section 94
cited_cases: Saroj & Ors Vs. Iffco-Tokio General Insurance Co. & Ors, (2024) INSC 819

outcome.final_order: Petitioners were granted protection on the apprehension of threat, harassment and interference.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for protection from harassment and interference
